dioscorides.excerpt: ἀνθεμίς· οἱ δὲ λευκάνθεμον, οἱ δὲ ἠράνθεμον, ἐπεὶ ἔαρος ἀνθεῖ, οἱ δὲ χαμαίμηλον διὰ τὴν πρὸς τὰ μῆλα ὁμοιότητα τῆς ὀσμῆς
dioscorides.edition: Wellmann 1906-1914 (vol. I 1907, vol. II 1906), Berlin: Weidmann; transcribed by eye from the archive.org page scan (Wellmann's ϑ glyph rendered as θ; no emendation)

identification.source: Sprengel, K. 1830. Pedanii Dioscoridis Anazarbei De materia medica libri quinque, tomus secundus (Commentarius in Dioscoridem), Medicorum Graecorum Opera vol. 26, Leipzig, Comm. lib. III cap. CXLIV, p. 559 (anthemis = three species by ray colour; Sibthorp: Anthemis chia, A. tinctoria, A. rosea; Lobel: Matricaria chamomilla / Anthemis nobilis for the white-rayed kind) and cap. CXLV, p. 560 (Sprengel himself identifies παρθένιον, Wellmann III 138, as Matricaria chamomilla)

caveats: Identification is disputed; results describe Matricaria chamomilla L., which may not be the plant Dioscorides meant.
